subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 packet, wishlist, and deployment timing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Avery Liu <avery@signalflow.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 packet, wishlist, and deployment timing

Hi Avery — great to meet today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

• Primary goal: pilot Redwood Inference for 3 microservices (chat assist, search re-rank, and embeddings) — latency budget ~120ms P95, target throughput 80rps.
• Top priorities for your team: data isolation (VPC), audit logging retention, and SOC 2 evidence for onboarding.
• Timeline you mentioned: internal security review this week, procurement decision by mid-November if there are no blockers.

Attachments: I’ve included the SOC 2 packet and a short deployment matrix to map requirements to product features: redwood_soc2_packet_v3.pdf, deployment_matrix.xlsx, network_diagram.png. 

Next steps (proposed):
1) Security team review of the SOC 2 packet — please let me know any gaps or questions by EOD Thu 11/5.
2) If helpful, I can schedule a 30-min session with our security engineer (Monica) to walk through controls and evidence.
3) If SignalFlow wants a procurement/contract checklist, I’ll loop Markus and get a draft SOW and pricing cadence ready.

If you prefer a security call, give me 2 windows that work and I’ll get Monica on. Thanks again — happy to keep this light and collaborative.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachments: redwood_soc2_packet_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.6MB); deployment_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 24KB); network_diagram.png (PNG, 180KB)

Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 packet, wishlist, and deployment timing

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the clear recap and the packet. I’ve forwarded the SOC 2 packet to our security team (security@signalflow.ai) and asked them to prioritize.

Two quick notes:
• They may ask for evidence around retention configuration and audit log export cadence — I’ll push those specific asks to the top.
• Procurement is tentatively planning a mid-November review but that’s dependent on security clearing the packet.

I’ll loop back once I hear from them. If your team is available next week for a brief call, I’ll propose times.

—Avery
Head of Platform Integrations | SignalFlow
avery@signalflow.ai

No pressure — just want to make the review as frictionless as possible since your procurement window looks tight.
